brief:
An Israeli settler attacked two cyclists and ran over one of them on lands in Halhul, north of Hebron, Eye on Palestine reported. Details of injuries were not immediately available.

The incident occurred in an area where Palestinian civilians face frequent confrontations with settlers. Halhul, located in the northern West Bank, has experienced repeated clashes between residents and Israeli settlers in recent years.
